name: Unidentified green-skied planet
description: The Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Senator Dewell Bronk had to change transports on a planet with green colored skies while trying to flee Coruscant following the end of the Clone Wars. Bronk encountered a pair of clone troopers who tried to arrest him on his way to his transport at Pad 560, but Kenobi saved him, allowing him to successfully leave the world.
